questions.question: Which statement best describes Consumption-based model?

questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the consumption-based model
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Consumption-based model: a model in which you pay for the IT resources you use and can release them when they are no longer needed.
Capital expenditure (CapEx): adding more resource instances when demand increases.
Capital expenditure (CapEx): up-front spending on physical infrastructure such as servers, networking equipment, and datacenter space.
Consumption-based model: cloud pricing in which charges generally track actual service consumption.
Operational expenditure (OpEx): a beginner-oriented series that introduces Azure services, cloud concepts, governance, and management.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Consumption-based model — a model in which you pay for the IT resources you use and can release them when they are no longer needed; and Capital expenditure (CapEx) — up-front spending on physical infrastructure such as servers, networking equipment, and datacenter space.
